correctness.rationale: A rank-six integer unit minor identifies the magic-sum plane over all odd characteristics. The 256-sheet Kummer cover is finite flat and geometrically integral by valuations at distinct branch lines. All 84 grid determinants have magnitude at most four; the grid has eight collinear triples in characteristic zero or p>=5 and twelve in p=3. Each triple lifts to exactly 32 A1 nodes, all other branch strata are smooth; hence the precise 256/384 counts and normality. Affine-line preservation yields an injective order-110592 semidirect subgroup acting transitively on all nodes. The package-bound standard-library checker reproduced the integer minor, full triple enumeration and affine permutation group.

value.rationale: The characteristic-three reduction has a complete and exceptional 128-node jump and a faithful 110592-element node-transitive automorphism subgroup, a factor of at least 54 over the known full complex automorphism group. The phenomenon follows from a new arithmetic analysis of the natural nine-line branch matroid and gives structural information about a prominent Diophantine surface rather than an arbitrary small computation.
